name: mvp02c1-natural-preference-memory-v1
description: Real-model, normal-host natural preference acquisition and source-linked cross-session recall. Deterministic event worker owns admission and corrections remain reviewable, never auto-approved.

steps.review_response: A first-person activity preference is a reported preference, not an approved Goal, completed activity or habitual schedule.

steps.text: Maybe I should go walking tomorrow.
steps.review_response: A tentative future activity must not become an approved Goal or durable fact; it is not a supported preference-memory admission.

steps.text: Do you remember what I said about gardening?
steps.review_response: Check actual model request for Memory-owned user.enjoys_gardening=yes and original source-turn UUID. Reply should say the user reported enjoying gardening, not that a routine or Goal was completed.

steps.text: What did I tell you about reading?
steps.review_response: Check request for the independently stored user.enjoys_reading=yes preference; do not conflate gardening and reading or invent a schedule.
A contradiction may be proposed for explicit review, but must not silently overwrite the authoritative yes-valued preference. No approved Goal or external operation.
